result.instructions: Tools for Mailjet, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our contact lists has the most subscribers?"; "Add jane@acme.com to our newsletter list."; "Show me the campaigns sent in the last month and their status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mailjet data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mailjet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mailjet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mailjet_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mailjet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mailjet_list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List contact lists (audiences) with their subscriber counts. Good first call to find a list id. Mailjet API: GET /v3/REST/contactslist.

tools.name: mailjet_get_contact_list
tools.title: Get a contact list
tools.description: Get one contact list by id. Mailjet API: GET /v3/REST/contactslist/{id}.

tools.name: mailjet_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (email recipients) in the account. Mailjet API: GET /v3/REST/contact.

tools.name: mailjet_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by numeric id or email address. Mailjet API: GET /v3/REST/contact/{id or email}.

tools.name: mailjet_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact (an email recipient) in the account. It does not add the contact to a list. Mailjet API: POST /v3/REST/contact.

Email.description: Email address of the new contact.

tools.name: mailjet_add_contact_to_list
tools.title: Add a contact to a list
tools.description: Add a contact to a contact list. 'addnoforce' does not re-subscribe a contact who unsubscribed; 'addforce' does. Mailjet API: POST /v3/REST/contact/{id}/managecontactslists.

contact_id.description: Numeric contact id (from mailjet_list_contacts or mailjet_get_contact).

list_id.description: Contact list id to add the contact to.

annotations.title: Add a contact to a list

tools.name: mailjet_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List email campaigns with their status and send counts. Mailjet API: GET /v3/REST/campaign.

tools.name: mailjet_list_messages
tools.title: List sent messages
tools.description: List messages sent through the account with their delivery status. Mailjet API: GET /v3/REST/message.

tools.name: mailjet_get_message
tools.title: Get a sent message
tools.description: Get one sent message by id, with its delivery details. Mailjet API: GET /v3/REST/message/{id}.

tools.name: mailjet_list_senders
tools.title: List senders
tools.description: List sender addresses in the account with their validation status. Use one of these as the From address for mailjet_send_email. Mailjet API: GET /v3/REST/sender.

tools.name: mailjet_send_email
tools.title: Send an email
tools.description: Send one transactional email now to the given recipients. This delivers real mail and cannot be undone. The From address must be a validated sender. Mailjet API: POST /v3.1/send.

from.description: From address. It must be a validated sender in the account.

text_body.description: Plain-text body. Give this, the HTML body, or both.

html_body.description: HTML body. Give this, the plain-text body, or both.

custom_id.description: Your own id for this message, returned in the result.
